subject: Wavefront Health — plan consolidation, sandbox seats & bundle pricing

Cc: procurement@wavefronthealth.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Wavefront Health — exploring consolidation + sandbox seats

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile and the prefix caching discussion. We're reassessing our footprint and would like to discuss two things:

1) Consolidating our three active projects (ClinicalQA, IntakeBot, and SearchRank) onto a single dedicated plan to simplify billing and model governance.
2) Adding 20 sandbox seats for developer experimentation tied to the ClinicalQA project for 12 months.

Can you share: a) a one‑page pricing view showing the committed capacity tiers that would cover our peak load (we're currently at ~120 rps across projects but expect burst to 250 rps), b) how add‑on seat billing works for sandboxes, and c) any promotional pricing for first‑year expansion?

Procurement looped in for timing. We need a proposal and SOW by EOD next Tuesday (2026‑07‑14) to hit next quarter's budget window.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director, Platform Engineering
Wavefront Health

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Wavefront Health — exploring consolidation + sandbox seats

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear ask and the usage snapshot. Quick replies inline: 

• Consolidation: we can map ClinicalQA + IntakeBot + SearchRank onto a single Dedicated plan with capacity headroom. I sketched two options (committed capacity vs. headroom buffer) and attached a simple pricing model.
• Sandbox seats: billable monthly as add‑ons; standard seat is $50/mo for dev seats on hosted sandbox, with a 12‑month prepay option that reduces to $40/mo. Seats do not consume GPU capacity but are gated by concurrency limits.
• Promotion: I can internally request a first‑year expansion credit — typical approvals are between 10–20% depending on ARR commitment.

I’ve attached an initial SOW template (Wavefront_MAAP_SOW_v2.pdf) and a pricing spreadsheet (wavefront_pricing_model_2026.xlsx). Ben, can you weigh in on typical discount band we give for a consolidation + sandbox bundle for mid‑market healthcare? Marissa — flagging for discount approval if needed.

Next steps: Ben to propose a recommended tier and discount band; I’ll prepare the SOW that matches his recommended tier for your review.

Best,
Evelyn Hart

Evelyn / Marissa,

Recommended approach based on their usage:

Option A — Conservative (recommended):
- Dedicated tier: 2x T4p pools (sustained throughput target ~180 rps)
- 20 sandbox seats prepaid 12 months @ $40/mo = $9,600 annual
- List price ARR delta: $120k / year
- Typical discount band for mid‑market consolidation + sandbox = 12%–15% first year (volume + marketing reference).

Option B — Aggressive (preferred if they commit to 18 month):
- Dedicated tier: 3x T4p pools (headroom to 250 rps)
- Sandbox seats same pricing
- List price ARR delta: $180k / year
- Discount band: 15%–20% first year; require 18 month commit or higher logo placement credit.

Notes: sandbox seats are additive and revenue‑positive; we do not count them as GPU capacity. For healthcare customers we prefer to keep the discount to max 20% to preserve margin.

Marissa — can you approve up to 15% for first year on a 12 month commitment? If they agree to 18 months we can consider 20% with a co‑sponsored case study.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
